name: BVH Ray Traversal with Stack
definition: A stack-based iterative algorithm for traversing a Bounding Volume Hierarchy (BVH) to find the closest ray-triangle intersection. It handles multiple entities by iterating through them and traversing each entity's BVH.
summary: BVH Ray Traversal with Stack is an iterative algorithm that uses a fixed-size explicit stack to efficiently find the closest ray-triangle intersection across multiple entities.
